notes.title: Alpha Playtest #4 - After Gamers Assembly
notes.content:
We had the pleasure to expose our game for the first time at Gamers Assembly 2025, biggest LAN in France: the public reception was better than expected.

It was so cool to see people enjoying our games. I was afraid the game was too difficult for casual players but it went well whatever their ages or gaming experience. 

Our discord reached 100 members, it's time to celebrate with a playtest :)

Join us for tomorrow: https://discord.gg/s42SZZN8?event=1365600150709469245

notes.title: Playtest Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hi! 

I hope you are doing well. I'm finally ready to launch this first playtest session :). 
This Alpha will be playable for 1 week:  [b]Monday 8 to Sunday 14[/b]. 
It is preferable you find friends to play with: It's not too late to register. 

I have setup servers in [b]Europe[/b] and [b]North America[/b], other regions will have to wait. The maximum ping allowed is 150.

The planning will be as follow:

July 8-10  : FFA, public servers, 3 game modes
July 11-14: team mode, private lobbies (all modes, admin choice)

I'm thinking of closing this session by a tournament. We will see.

See you on Monday I hope!

Sylvain
